english.note: Use this as the everyday choice when a person or group physically moves back from a position.
Use this when a person or non-vehicle moves backward; use 倒車 for reversing a vehicle.

examples.english: You are standing too close, so retreat a little.
examples.traditional: 你企得太埋喇，退後少少啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 kei5 dak1 taai3 maai4 laa3 teoi3 hau6 siu2 siu2 laa1

examples.english: Back up a little so I can get through.
examples.traditional: 你退後少少，等我行過去。
examples.jyutping: nei5 teoi3 hau6 siu2 siu2 dang2 ngo5 haang4 gwo3 heoi3
